name: Hikkantaka Rasa

sections.overview: Hikkantaka Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.introduction: Hikkantaka Rasa is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to prepare from the mixture of effective minerals and herbs.
sections.ingredients:
Swarna bhasma – Calcined Aurum 
 Mukta pishti – Processed Pearl 
 Tamra bhsama – copper calx 
 Loha bhsama – calcined iron 
 Lemon – Citrus Medica 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take the ingredients from number one to four and mix well. Now tinctured this mixture with Lemon’s juice. 
 After tincture process, took 125 mg paste and make pills from it. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Hikkantaka Rasa is an Ayurvedic medicine primarily used to manage the problem of hiccups. It helps to manage the involuntary contractions of the diaphragm because the each contraction is followed by a sudden closure of vocal cords that produces the distinctive “hic” sound. Diaphragm eases the process of breathing also. It helps to stimulate the nerves in the throat regions and thus manages the hiccups.
sections.dose: One to three pills, two to three times a day, with lemon juice, honey and black salt.
sections.contraindications:
Take medicine under doctor’s prescription. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Hikkantaka Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Rasatantra Sar (first part); edition 13; 440 – 441. 
 Introduction 
 Hikkantaka Rasa is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to prepare from the mixture of effective minerals and herbs. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Swarna bhasma – Calcined Aurum 
 Mukta pishti – Processed Pearl 
 Tamra bhsama – copper calx 
 Loha bhsama – calcined iron 
 Lemon – Citrus Medica 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take the ingredients from number one to four and mix well. Now tinctured this mixture with Lemon’s juice. 
 After tincture process, took 125 mg paste and make pills from it. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Hikkantaka Rasa is an Ayurvedic medicine primarily used to manage the problem of hiccups. It helps to manage the involuntary contractions of the diaphragm because the each contraction is followed by a sudden closure of vocal cords that produces the distinctive “hic” sound. Diaphragm eases the process of breathing also. It helps to stimulate the nerves in the throat regions and thus manages the hiccups. 
 Indications 
 
 Hiccups 
 
 Dose 
 One to three pills, two to three times a day, with lemon juice, honey and black salt. 
 Contraindications 
 Take medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
